postconditions.expression: all(organ_in_correct_position(organ, grid, k) for organ in range(1, 4 * k + 2))
postconditions.description: All organs are in their correct positions in the grid.
The sequence of moves is finite and does not involve cycles that can be reached from the main sequence.

postconditions.expression: all(move_is_valid(move, grid) for move in moves)
postconditions.description: All moves in the sequence are valid and do not result in an invalid grid configuration.
The sequence of moves does not contain any cycles that can be reached from the main sequence.
All shortcuts used in the output are legal and do not lead to an infinite sequence of moves.
